_note: Villagers' requests (VillagerRequests, 2026-10-23, Selwyn: 'Helping villagers XP'). A resident asks once (a chat topic), Mika says yes, the request stays open in her mind (saved) until she brings what was asked (items she gathered) or has done it (a spell at the named target), then she goes back to them and they thank her. One open request per resident, at most MAX_OPEN at once. XP: progression.json first_activity 'help:' and first_knowledge 'helped_resident:' (proposed rates, waiting for Selwyn's OK). need: {item, n} or {magic_target}.

requests.ask: My moonpetals won't open this season. Could you bring me two from your sanctuary? They grow wild up there.
requests.reply: Two moonpetals, from our garden. I'll bring them, promise.
requests.thanks: Oh, they're perfect! Look how they glow. I'll press one for you.
requests.done_reply: They seemed happy to come down the mountain.

requests.ask: An embercap in the oven makes the crust sing. I've had none since spring. Could you find me one?
requests.reply: An embercap for the oven. I know just where they grow.
requests.thanks: You remembered! Tomorrow's loaves are yours, both of you.
requests.done_reply: I want to hear the crust sing.

requests.ask: The lantern crystal in the square went dim a week ago. My old eyes hate the dark lane. Could your magic wake it?
requests.reply: I'll wake the lantern crystal for you. It shouldn't stay dark.
requests.thanks: I saw it light up from the forge! Like a little sunrise. Thank you, mage.
requests.done_reply: It was only sleeping. It just needed someone to ask.

requests.ask: Embercap smoke keeps the wolves off the river road. Two would see me through the week.
requests.reply: Two embercaps for the river road. Leave it to me.
requests.thanks: Two of them! The wolves won't come near the field now. You've a kind heart.
requests.done_reply: Stay safe on the river road, Odo.

requests.ask: Those lights on the observatory hill. Would you wake the star rune up there, so I know the next ones are yours?
requests.reply: I'll go up the hill and wake the star rune. Then you'll know.
requests.thanks: There it was, plain as day, a star on the hill. I'll sleep easier on watch.
requests.done_reply: If you see seven points of light, that's me saying hello.

requests.ask: I press flowers into the old herbals, to keep the pages company. A moonpetal would be a treasure.
requests.reply: A moonpetal for your herbals. I'll find a good one.
requests.thanks: Oh. It still glows, even pressed. The book will like that.
requests.done_reply: Now the pages have a night light.

requests.ask: Could you show me on the arena's practice crystal? Just once, how a spell is supposed to land?
requests.reply: Of course. Watch the practice crystal, I'll show you.
requests.thanks: I saw it! You don't push, you let it go. I'll try that tomorrow.
requests.done_reply: Let it go, don't push. You've got it.

requests.ask: The garden's bloom rune hasn't flowered since the exams. Everyone's too scared to touch it. Would you?
requests.reply: I'm not scared of a flower rune. I'll wake it.
requests.thanks: It bloomed! The whole garden smells of it. Come study with us sometime.
requests.done_reply: Tell the others it was only shy.

requests.ask: The hamlet oven sulks without embercap in the kindling. If you pass this way again, bring one?
requests.reply: One embercap for the hamlet oven, next time we pass.
requests.thanks: There she goes, roaring like a dragon. Stop for bread whenever you like.
requests.done_reply: We'll stop for bread, I promise.

requests.ask: My bees go mad for moonpetal. Just one, and they'd make the sweetest honey this side of the river.
requests.reply: A moonpetal for the bees. They deserve it.
requests.thanks: Listen to them hum! You'll have the first jar, both of you.
